phrases.latin: Inde per viam tabernīs vestiāriīs et cuppēdināriīs plēnam ad portam urbis antīquam vēnērunt
phrases.english: From there they went along a street full of clothes shops and cake shops to the old city gate
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: 29 October 2026 additions: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 173, checked against the searchable text of the book.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
